recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中造血細胞被一片淡粉紅、纖維狀的間質取代，其中散布卵圓至梭形核的類上皮組織球、淋巴球與少量嗜酸性球及核碎片，為邊界不清的肉芽腫反應。
features: Loose infiltrate of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated vesicular nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes and scattered eosinophils
Pale pink, loosely fibrillar/granular stromal background replacing hematopoietic elements
No well-formed multinucleated giant cells or caseous necrosis in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows replacement of hematopoietic tissue by a loose infiltrate of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated vesicular nuclei, admixed lymphocytes, scattered eosinophils, and karyorrhectic debris in a pale, loosely fibrillar stroma. Well-formed giant cells and caseous necrosis are not seen. Findings are consistent with a poorly formed granulomatous process; in HIV infection, AFB and GMS stains and cultures are recommended to exclude mycobacterial and fungal infection.

ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation has amorphous pale extracellular material with few cells and no epithelioid histiocyte aggregates.
Fibrosis shows spindled fibroblasts with collagen and atypical megakaryocytes, whereas histiocytes here are CD68 positive epithelioid cells.
Hodgkin involvement contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in the mixed infiltrate, which are not identified here.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterium avium complex infection with foamy histiocytes
ddx.vs: MAC in advanced HIV may show sheets of foamy histiocytes packed with AFB-positive bacilli rather than well-formed granulomas; AFB stain separates them.
